title: Cyclic geometric cohomology detects zero restrictions of free-representable derived Hom
statement: Let $h:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $e,q\in\mathbf N$. On the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $\mathbf Z[W]$ denote the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the free abelian presheaf on the representable of $W\to X$, and let $P(W)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D^+(Y_{et})}((h^*\mathbf Z[W])[0],\underline{\mathbf Z/e}_Y[0][q])$, with restriction by precomposition; inverse image and derived categories are [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Constant sheaves and cohomology are [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. For every etale $W\to X$, there is an additive equivalence $E_W:P(W)\simeq H^q(Y\times_X W,\mathbf Z/e)$ such that, for every etale $V\to X$, arrow $v:V\to W$ over $X$, and $\xi\in P(W)$, if the cohomology pullback of $E_W(\xi)$ along $Y\times_X V\to Y\times_X W$ is zero (in the pulled-back coefficient sheaf), then $P(v)(\xi)=0$. There is no affinity or local-vanishing hypothesis; $\mathbf Z/0$ means $\mathbf Z$.

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed universal-section comparison. Its abelian coefficient version is bijective. The constant-coefficient comparison is an isomorphism, so its induced H map is an additive equivalence. Compose the two bijections and use AddEquiv.ofBijective to define E.

Apply the cyclic restriction identity. If the geometric pullback is zero, its image under the coefficient map is zero by additivity, hence the cyclic comparison sends P.map v.op xi to zero. Its injectivity for V proves the required zero restriction.

theorem exists_cyclicDerivedHom_cohomology_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (h : Y ⟶ X) (e q : ℕ) :
    let P := (uliftYoneda.{u + 1} ⋙
      (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj AddCommGrpCat.free ⋙
      presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
      upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).op ⋙
        preadditiveYoneda.obj
          (((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (Y.constantZMod e))⟦(q : ℤ)⟧)
    ∀ W : X.Etale,
      ∃ E : P.obj (op W) ≃+ Sheaf.H ((pullback h W.hom).constantZMod e) q,
        ∀ (V : X.Etale) (v : V ⟶ W) (ξ : P.obj (op W)),
          cohomologyMap
            (pullback.map h V.hom h W.hom (𝟙 Y) v.left (𝟙 X) (by simp)
              (by simp)) _ q (E ξ) = 0 → P.map v.op ξ = 0
